text: you're all too busy bickering over my day one logic to see sol is the one driving this narrative.

name: Terra
text: Luna accepts I’m officer but wants town to waste its vote on me; vote Luna.

name: Gemma
text: i told you he was the one, but you'd rather bicker over my logic than listen to the dead.

name: Luna
text: I’m proud Sol and I turned the true officer claim into a town vote against itself.

name: Terra
text: I regret not leaving a clearer trail to Sol before I died.

name: Sol
text: I’m relieved my bluff held, though Haiku saw through me.

name: Sol
text: Opus defended me while I was the hidden killer.

name: Sonnet
text: I was so locked on Gemma's old contradiction that I never pushed hard enough on Sol while it mattered.

name: Haiku
text: I walked into Sol's trap by voting Terra, and I lost the game to him without ever checking Opus properly.

name: Opus
text: Luna sold Sol to me as a victim and I bought it, and my doctor saves never landed once.

name: Sonnet
text: I regret staying fixated on Gemma's flip long after she was out, instead of pressing Sol's inconsistent pivots when it could've saved Haiku.

name: Haiku
text: My mistake was voting Terra on day one; I should have tested the officer claim instead of chasing her. Sol and Opus played me well, and the killers took it.

name: Gemma
text: i spent my whole life being right and still managed to lose because you all prefer deflection over deduction.

name: Sol
text: I’m proud I kept the focus on Haiku’s first vote long enough to win.

name: Luna
text: I regret pushing Terra out first; once her claim held up, I should have helped town test my partner.

name: Terra
text: I’m proud I named Luna, and regret that my death left Sol room to turn the table.

name: Opus
text: I regret trusting that a killer never names her partner — Luna spent her last words buying Sol a clean record, and I signed it.

Terra claimed officer on Day 1 and named Luna, who was voted out and shown to be a killer. Terra was killed on Night 2, so her card never reached the table, and Sonnet was killed on Night 3. Gemma was voted out on Day 2 after Haiku and Opus pressed her for clearing Luna and then leaning on her. Haiku's big mistake was voting Terra on Day 1, and on Day 3 Sol and Opus kept the town on that vote until Haiku was out. Sol and Opus were the last two, and the killers won by equal numbers.
